resources.string: Records your work calls with the microphone so Sales Xray can analyse them.

Sales Xray uses this only to record phone calls: Android lets an app hear the microphone during a call only through Accessibility. It records only while a call is on, a phone call or an internet call such as WhatsApp, and only after you switch on Record calls in Sales Xray. It does not read your screen, your messages or any other app, and does nothing else. Recordings stay on this phone until you choose to analyse one. Tell the other person the call is recorded.
